arguments.value: This agreement says Beike Internet Security and Baidu will cooperate for two years by integrating Baidu search and promotion services into Beike’s products, especially the Kingsoft Navigation/Cheetah Browser software. Beike must display Baidu’s search box, use Baidu as the default search service in certain places, follow Baidu’s cooperation rules, avoid working with certain competitors without permission, and protect Baidu’s technology and trademarks. Baidu must provide the search and traffic-tracking services, pay Beike a revenue share based on search traffic and agreed rates, and supply monthly settlement data. Both sides must keep confidential information secret, respect each other’s intellectual property, and follow PRC law. The agreement can be terminated for breach, expiry, bankruptcy, or prolonged force majeure, and disputes are to be handled first by negotiation and then in Baidu’s local court.
